title: Add autonomy handoff bundle verifier
summary: The handoff bundle can export tracked patches and untracked text content, but there is not yet a separate verifier that checks bundle schema, path safety, and content digests before another environment restores it. Add a read-only verifier for bundle JSON from stdin or file.
expectedFailureModes: A corrupted handoff bundle is accepted and another environment reconstructs the wrong files.
Unsafe absolute or traversal paths in bundle contents are accepted.
The verifier writes files or Git metadata while checking a bundle.
nextAction: Add an autonomy handoff bundle verifier with stdin/file input, verify patch and untracked-file digests plus path safety, document it in autonomous workflow docs, and validate it against a generated bundle.
